best: The 3V3 buck and the USB four-switch power stage, 5 V buck and BQ25756 dividers/sense filters are wired left to right and read like textbook circuits with titled blocks.
worst: Cells and Gauge is largely label-tied fragments: sense resistor, back-to-back protection FETs, fuse, ignition FET, D101, pack caps and connectors float alone, with auto-named Net-(U101-xx) labels and gauge decoupling caps hung on a CELL_1N rail far from their pins, so the pack path cannot be followed without net search.

Text collisions: resistor ref/value text overlapping net labels around U101 (R105/R106/R117, C106), PACK_P label over J113's value, C313 text over its net label, stacked ground pin numbers on U401/U405, and the MCU antenna-match title running off the page.

Poor use of space and split sub-circuits: 3V3 uses only the top strip, MCU is mostly empty with the antenna pi network split (C314 stranded top right), pull-ups parked on a rail away from their pins, and USB TVS, EEPROM, Q409 and decoupling caps floating apart from what they serve.
